info.name: Airtm Enterprise API V1 Account Status API

params.name: email
params.description: Email associated with the account to check.

items.docs:
Retrieve the current status of any user's account by providing their
email in the request headers. The response will return the user's client
ID, account status, whether the email corresponds to the primary account
(Airtm allows up to two secondary emails per account), the country where
the account is registered, the verification status, and the full name
registered on the account.

**The email parameter should be URL Encoded. You can learn more about
encoding urls here:**
